scale.name: Weak
scale.description: Vague story, unclear personal ownership, little measurement, no reflection.

scale.name: Acceptable
scale.description: Clear story and actions, but limited senior-level trade-off reasoning or system change.

scale.name: Strong
scale.description: Concrete ownership, trade-offs, measurable outcome, learning, and durable operating change.

scale.name: Exceptional
scale.description: Shows executive judgment, cross-functional influence, second-order consequences, and repeatable leadership mechanisms.
